entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling because I'd like to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a fit and comfort issue. I've tried them on a few rides, adjusted the cleats multiple times, but they're just not working out. I keep getting painful blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key for a good ride, and blisters are definitely not what we want for our customers. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0951-B. The order was for the Pro-Level cycling shoes.
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the shoes were delivered about 55 days ago.
That sounds about right. I know it's been a bit, but I really wanted to give them a fair chance.
No problem at all. I'm checking our policy now, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I am a long-time customer and I have to go through the trouble of packing these up and sending them back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm already looking at another pair on your site.

That's a reasonable request. I can see here that you are a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience, I can certainly offer you a 15% discount code for your next order. I'll include that in the return confirmation email I'm sending you now.
Perfect. A full refund and a discount code works for me. Thank you, Diana, you've been very helpful.

You're most welcome! The email with the return label and your discount code is on its way. Once we receive the cycling shoes, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
